column1: # Credential files synced with Vaultwarden by `secrets` (~/.local/bin/secrets).
# One line per file. The item lives in the Vaultwarden folder "Secrets/<group>".
#   hosts:  comma-separated hostnames, or * for every machine
#   format: env  (KEY=value)   fish (set -gx KEY value)   raw (whole file)
#   /opt/docker/*/.env           root-owned stack secrets, server-only, restic backs them up
#   ~/.config/hevy-mcp/token.json  OAuth token the MCP refreshes itself - a synced copy goes stale
